{{Youmay|the [[Yevetha]]n title|[[Second|another use of the word]]}}
In [[Yevetha]]n culture, a '''second''' was a male who acted as the number two of another, stronger ''[[nitakka]]''.<ref name="BFC1">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref>

The term was often associated with a position corresponding to that of [[Executive officer/Legends|executive officer]] aboard [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]]. When [[Nil Spaar]] was given command of the ''[[Beauty of Yevetha]]'' to scout the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]], his second [[Dar Bile]] accompanied him.<ref name="BFC1" /> In [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]], when the warship ''[[Blessings]]'' failed to match the expected standard of readiness, both the commanding [[Primate (Yevethan rank)|primate]] and his second were executed, to emphasise that the price of failure could also be imposed on subordinates.<ref name="BFC1" />

When a powerful ''nitakka'' rose in status, his second would rise with him, and for this reason, the title could also be used at higher and lower levels of authority. When Nil Spaar had been the young leader of an insurgency against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] occupation, Dar Bille was already acting as his second, and in that role, served as his subaltern in a small [[commando]] [[squad]].<ref name="BFC1" /> After their mission aboard the ''Beauty'', when they overthrew [[Kiv Truun]] and Nil Spaar became the ruling [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] of the [[Duskhan League]], Dar Bille remained his second,<ref name="BFC1" /> but he was eventually appointed to a largely autonomous role in command the flagship [[Intimidator (Executor-class)|''Pride of Yevetha'']], a position of authority in which he was simultaneously the appointed [[Proctor (Yevethan)|proctor]] of the Viceroy,<ref name="BFC3">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref> and the commanding primate of the ship,<ref name="BFC1" /> perhaps with a second of his own. There were situations where the viceroy's lesser proctors, such as [[Tal Fraan]], made their ritual submission to the second rather than to Nil Spaar in person.<ref name="BFC3" />

==Behind the scenes==
The concept of the "second" was invented by novelist [[Michael P. Kube-McDowell]] in the [[The Black Fleet Crisis|''Black Fleet'' trilogy]].

The term appears to only be used explicitly in the first novel in the series, ''[[Before the Storm]]'', and not in the sequels ''[[Shield of Lies]]'' and ''[[Tyrant's Test]]''.
